reviews.text: How can I get in touch? Both of the numbers I have just ring!
Just so you know, they are no longer open on Saturdays. I'll go during the week to check if they're open.
Excellent service. My dog ​​was seen by the veterinarian.

Excellent service from the moment you arrive!

Very good!

I recommend it!!!

I would like to express my heartfelt gratitude to the entire team for the care provided to my Ronny.
Even during such a difficult time, I was welcomed by extremely humane, competent, and efficient professionals. I witnessed the commitment of each one to try to save him. At no point was he left without assistance; everyone worked quickly, with dedication, and with great care.
Unfortunately, Ronny did not survive. But I leave with the certainty that absolutely everything within the team's reach was done. This brought comfort to my heart amidst the pain of parting.
I have never seen such efficient and committed care. You took care not only of my dog ​​but also of me, during one of the most difficult moments of my life.
My eternal gratitude and admiration to all of you. Thank you for fighting for my boy until the end. ❤️
The medical team is wonderful and attentive. They truly do what they love. They adore the animals.

I'm not stating anything definitively, but I get the feeling that veterinarians are "obligated" to prescribe gabapentin (a strong anti-anxiety medication) for pets that don't need it. I can't trust them anymore.
Excellent!!! World-class veterinary medical team! Dr. Thais is very dedicated, professional, and treats everyone with compassion!!!

For years, our kitten has been cared for and monitored by the wonderful medical teams at this Hospital, and the result is the quality of life he has enjoyed in his old age.
We are very grateful to everyone and highly recommend this institution.

Simply the BEST place I've ever taken my pets, and I've been to several private clinics, from the most expensive to the most affordable, and there's no comparison. Everything is perfect: the education, the way they handle the pets—you can see it's out of LOVE! The confidence in what they're doing impressed me. Not to mention they resuscitated my dog, and tomorrow I'll be there taking the other one, which is very difficult for me because it's so far away. But the other clinic just relies on guesswork and is taking your money. Of course, if they order a trillion tests somewhere, they're bound to get it right somewhere. So he didn't see me at that clinic anymore, and may God even use those angels who helped my Toninho, so they can help my Durval.
There's a lovely veterinarian, I nicknamed her "half a kilo of skinny girl," but this girl is INCREDIBLE and she's only 23 years old, her parents must be very proud. I mentioned her because she's taking care of Toninho and he's in love with her, but they are all WONDERFUL. I didn't put their names because I don't know them. Girls, may God continue to work through you! YOU ARE INCREDIBLE.
Big hug from a guardian (mother) who thanks God for having met you.
NOTE: WHO RECOMMENDED YOU TO ME WAS
MY COUSIN WHO IS A VETERINARIAN AT USP.
